//: Type-checking the Edge Function, which the root tsconfig.json does not reach:
its `include` is [src] only, so `npx tsc --noEmit` and `npm run build` both
report a clean tree while handler.ts goes unchecked.
That gap is not hypothetical. handler.ts is the file holding the privileged
key's only caller, and a signature change there would have shipped silently.
The Node test harness does not catch it either - it runs this file under
type STRIPPING, which erases annotations without verifying them.
index.ts is deliberately excluded: it is the only file that touches Deno
globals, Deno.serve and Deno.env, and Deno is not a dependency here. Keeping
the privileged-key read in a three-line shim means the type-checked surface is
exactly the part that decides who may reset a password.
